actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit. I have experience building realtime analytics dashboards (including D3.js and alternatives), integrating with REST APIs, implementing role-based auth, and creating responsive interfaces with dark mode. I’m available to start next month and can complete a scoped MVP within your 4-week timeline. 

Before we hop on a call, could you share any API docs or example data, your preferred auth method (JWT/OAuth), and whether you have design mockups or an existing style guide? My typical approach would be to agree on a prioritized feature list, milestone-based deliverables, and use FreelanceHub escrow for payments. My rate for a project like this is $5,500 (flat) / open to discussing milestone split based on deliverables.

If that works, I’m happy to schedule a 30-minute call — I’m available weekdays between 10am–2pm CT. Let me know what time works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite. Looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer / Full-Stack Developer
